The code should use the 2D equation model from the fealpy library for the heat conduction equation, and the lagrange finite element space. The code should also handle Dirichlet boundary conditions. The code should iteratively refine the mesh based on the recovery estimate until the error is below the specified threshold. The code should also coarsen the mesh after each time step. import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from fealpy.mesh import TriangleMesh
from fealpy.functionspace import LagrangeFiniteElementSpace
from fealpy.boundarycondition import DirichletBC
from fealpy.timeintegratoralg import UniformTimeLine
from fealpy.tools import showmultirate
from fealpy.mesh.mesh_tools import find_node_with_value
from fealpy.decorator import timer
from fealpy.model.heat_conduction_model_2d import HeatConductionModel2D

import os

def main(
    nx=10, ny=10,  # spatial divisions
    nt=20,         # temporal divisions
    theta=0.2,     # adaptive refinement stop threshold
    refine_mark=0.3, # fraction of elements to refine
    coarsen_mark=0.05, # fraction of elements to coarsen
    T=0.1,         # final time
    plot_steps=[0, 5, 10, 15, 20], # time steps to plot solution
    mesh_dir='mesh_plots',
    solution_dir='solution_plots'
):
    if not os.path.exists(mesh_dir):
        os.makedirs(mesh_dir)
    if not os.path.exists(solution_dir):
        os.makedirs(solution_dir)

    # Define the model
    model = HeatConductionModel2D()
    domain = model.domain()
    mesh = TriangleMesh.from_box(domain, nx=nx, ny=ny)
    timeline = UniformTimeLine(0, T, nt)
    dt = timeline.dt

    # Finite element space
    p = 1
    space = LagrangeFiniteElementSpace(mesh, p=p)
    u = space.function()  # initial solution

    # Initial condition
    u[:] = model.u0(space.node)

    # Dirichlet boundary condition
    bc = DirichletBC(space, model.dirichlet, model.is_dirichlet_boundary)

    # Time stepping
    for k, t1 in enumerate(timeline[1:]):
        t0 = timeline[k]
        print(f"Time step {k+1}/{nt}, t = {t1:.4f}")

        # Assemble matrices
        A = space.stiff_matrix()
        M = space.mass_matrix()
        F = space.source_vector(lambda x: model.f(x, t1))

        # Left-hand side and right-hand side
        lhs = M + dt * A
        rhs = M @ u + dt * F

        # Apply Dirichlet BC
        bc.apply(lhs, rhs, u0=lambda x: model.dirichlet(x, t1))

        # Solve linear system
        u[:] = np.linalg.solve(lhs, rhs)

        # Error estimation and adaptive refinement
        while True:
            # Recovery-based error estimator
            eta = space.recovery_estimate(u)
            total_error = np.sqrt(np.sum(eta**2))
            print(f"  Recovery error: {total_error:.6e}")

            # Save mesh plot
            plt.figure()
            mesh.add_plot(plt)
            plt.title(f"Mesh at t={t1:.4f}, error={total_error:.2e}")
            plt.savefig(f"{mesh_dir}/mesh_t{k+1}_refine.png")
            plt.close()

            if total_error < theta:
                break

            # Mark elements for refinement
            idx = np.argsort(-eta)
            nrefine = max(1, int(refine_mark * mesh.number_of_cells()))
            cell_mark = np.zeros(mesh.number_of_cells(), dtype=np.int8)
            cell_mark[idx[:nrefine]] = 1  # mark for refinement

            # Refine mesh
            mesh.refine(cell_mark)
            space = LagrangeFiniteElementSpace(mesh, p=p)
            u = space.interpolation(u)
            bc = DirichletBC(space, model.dirichlet, model.is_dirichlet_boundary)

        # Coarsening
        eta = space.recovery_estimate(u)
        idx = np.argsort(eta)
        ncoarsen = max(1, int(coarsen_mark * mesh.number_of_cells()))
        cell_mark = np.zeros(mesh.number_of_cells(), dtype=np.int8)
        cell_mark[idx[:ncoarsen]] = -1  # mark for coarsening

        mesh.coarsen(cell_mark)
        space = LagrangeFiniteElementSpace(mesh, p=p)
        u = space.interpolation(u)
        bc = DirichletBC(space, model.dirichlet, model.is_dirichlet_boundary)

        # Save mesh plot after coarsening
        plt.figure()
        mesh.add_plot(plt)
        plt.title(f"Mesh at t={t1:.4f} after coarsening")
        plt.savefig(f"{mesh_dir}/mesh_t{k+1}_coarsen.png")
        plt.close()

        # Print error
        l2_error = space.integralalg.L2_error(lambda x: model.solution(x, t1), u)
        print(f"  L2 error at t={t1:.4f}: {l2_error:.6e}")

        # Plot solution at specified steps
        if (k+1) in plot_steps:
            fig = plt.figure()
            ax = fig.gca(projection='3d')
            space.add_plot(ax, u, cmap='rainbow')
            plt.title(f"Numerical solution at t={t1:.4f}")
            plt.savefig(f"{solution_dir}/solution_t{k+1}.png")
            plt.close()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main(
        nx=10,
        ny=10,
        nt=20,
        theta=0.01,
        refine_mark=0.3,
        coarsen_mark=0.05,
        T=0.1,
        plot_steps=[0, 5, 10, 15, 20],
        mesh_dir='mesh_plots',
        solution_dir='solution_plots'
    )
```
